definition.objective: sup over unit-gross separate long/short actions of E_P[u_1(n X)]
definition.gradient: sum_s D_s grad(X_s), D proportional to (p/q) u_1'(n X_s)
definition.validation_policy: held-out paths never enter fitting, convergence, or stopping

split.weight_definition: exp(log(p/q)); physical estimates are N^-1 sum_r (p/q)_r f_r

whitening.definition: xi_t=(x_t-m_t) Q_t Lambda_t^{-1/2}; m_t and covariance are estimated on training paths with physical p/q weights
